findings.title: Hardcoded secret / credential in source
findings.fixPrompt:
Fix one critical security issue that DeployReady found in this project.

Where: config.py:3
Issue: Hardcoded secret / credential in source (CWE-798, A02:2025)
What to change: Move the secret to an environment variable or secret manager, rotate the exposed value immediately, and ensure it is gitignored.

Keep the fix minimal: change only what this issue needs, do not change behaviour or refactor unrelated code, and never put real secrets in code or in your reply (use environment variables).
To confirm: re-run `npx deployready@latest analyze` and check this issue is gone, or call the DeployReady MCP `verify` tool with id "08180234729c".
